name: io.github.CyberPunk11147/cyberwarex-chain-data
description: MCP server for the CyberWareX Onchain Query API: EVM wallet balances, token info, price, gas, transactions and ENS across 5 chains. Tools: chain_wallet, chain_token, chain_price, chain_gas, chain_tx, chain_ens.

environmentVariables.name: CHAIN_X_PAYMENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional x402 X-PAYMENT header. If unset, the server surfaces the 402 invoice to the agent so its own x402 client can pay and retry.
